DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE -- an upstream defect, which this expectation encodes. PROJ's krovak inverse is not the inverse of PROJ's own forward: krovak_setup assigns P->a, P->es and P->e (9.8.1:src/projections/krovak.cpp:287-289) but never P->ra, and never calls pj_calc_ellipsoid_params, so under PJ_IO_UNITS_CLASSIC the forward scales by P->a = Bessel's 6377397.155 (9.8.1:src/fwd.cpp:142-143) while the inverse scales by P->ra = 1/6378137 left over from +ellps=GRS80 (9.8.1:src/inv.cpp:92-93). PROJ's own round trip misses by 138.6 m at the Guidance Note 7-2 point. proj4j derives totalScale from Bessel in both directions and round-trips exactly, and PROJ asked for the same inverse with +ellps=bessel reproduces proj4j's value exactly. Decision: keep proj4j's behaviour and change no code; matching PROJ would mean writing the stale reciprocal in on purpose. See KrovakProjection's class javadoc. Inverse of (200, 100) m: proj4j 24.836219260 59.758404029 vs expected 24.836218919 59.758403933, deviation 21.942407 mm, tolerance 0.100000 mm, metric GEODESIC_FROM_RADIANS.
